tools.name: skill_catalog
tools.title: List installed skills without their bodies
tools.description: Every skill the installed packages and marketplaces ship, grouped by package or plugin, with names, one-line descriptions and tier, and no bodies. Paged by group. Use it to see what exists, or when skill_find returns nothing.

tools.name: skill_find
tools.title: Find skills by describing the problem
tools.description: Ranked skill names for an intent. Describe the problem in a full sentence in English rather than a keyword: a single word matches far worse, and the ranking is over descriptions. Returns names only -- read one with skill_call.

intent.description: What you are trying to do, as an English sentence.

filters.description: Exact-match filters over the catalog before ranking.

tools.name: skill_describe
tools.title: Check one skill's properties before loading it
tools.description: Frontmatter, metadata (tier, level, requirements, licence, approval), and the files the skill carries with sizes and sha256, without any body. Use it to decide between candidates before skill_call.

name.description: The skill name skill_find or skill_catalog returned.

tools.name: skill_read
tools.title: Read one file a skill carries
tools.description: A reference or script file inside one skill's directory, as text, with its sha256. Read only when the skill body points at the file. Scripts are returned, never run. Files over 256 KiB and paths outside the skill are refused.

path.description: Path relative to the skill directory, as skill_describe lists it. Defaults to SKILL.md.

tools.name: skill_call
tools.title: Read one skill
tools.description: The body of a single skill, by the name skill_find or skill_catalog returned. This is the only call that costs a document.
